english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something has a high price or cost.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something that costs a lot.
Use 貴 as the all-purpose adjective when something has a high price.
Use 貴 when steep means that a price is expensive or excessive.
Use this when “stiff” means unusually expensive or pricey.
